title: Clearer Liquid Items (Cancelled)
description: Liquid and slime items become translucent!
body:
Reduce the opacity of liquids and slime to add realism to the game.

![Don't you notice something?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3acd6059f3ba51059d3fde299dbec10d6cb90391.png)

> Specific figures

  - Water/Potion(in bottles only) in bottles/cauldrons and droplet on a tipped arrow: Opacity: 90%

- Honey in a bottles and slime-type items: Opacity: 95%

> Note

- This resource pack is only compatible with the default texture pack.
It will not work correctly with Programmer Art.
